notes: normal: punches while the glove button is up. tracking: punches while it is held, when the right hand steers the mouse.
defence: camera body states, held while they last. BLOCK is off while tracking unless aim.block_while_tracking is true.

Street Fighter: guard down (both arms dropped) is W, up = jump; block is unbound, because holding back blocks in the game and W in guard would keep jumping. Slips A/D move, duck S crouches. Normal punches are six different keys, one for each of the left arm's JAB, HOOK, UPPERCUT and the right arm's CROSS, RIGHT HOOK, RIGHT UPPERCUT, for a game with six attack buttons (such as Street Fighter's three punches and three kicks): map them in the game's own controls. Defence keys are the Browser Boxing ones from browser_boxing.json, which still has the old punch keys.
